correctness.rationale: PASS: Independently regenerated all 240 permutations from the two published generators and all 288 4-simplices from the two orbit seeds, recovering f=(16,120,560,720,288). Independently formed exact GF(2) triangle-to-edge and tetrahedron-to-triangle boundary maps, ranks 105 and 433, yielding dim H2=560-105-433=22. All 1820 four-sets were exhausted, 720 facial and 1100 empty; every empty tetrahedral 2-sphere had nonzero quotient class. Exact reduction modulo im d3 gives precisely 508 distinct classes with multiplicities 320 single, 80 triple and 108 fivefold, accounting for 1100 cycles. Independent orbit enumeration gives seven support orbit sizes (20,60,60,240,240,240,240), and classes span rank 22. Inspected the supplied code for pairwise class-orbit overlap and full 6-orbit decomposition (20,48,60,60,80,240). On <=3 vertices no nonzero 2-cycle exists, while any 4-vertex nonzero cycle is the tetrahedral boundary, so the enumeration is an *exhaustive* classification of minimum-support classes for this fixed complex. No claim about other K3 triangulations/integral supports follows.

An exact classification of 1100 shortest support carriers into 508 classes, collisions of multiplicity 1/3/5, full symmetry orbit spectrum, and proof they span H2 is a natural nontrivial quotient-homology invariant; it distinguishes supports from classes and goes beyond raw f-vectors or known tightness. This finite exact standalone fact has mathematical significance without an all-K3 theorem.
